_comment: Frozen same-perm0 design (v2). AUTHORIZED for the school-side 4090D run on 2026-10-19, cap 15 GPU-hours; training_started remains false until the school runner starts. Only the PR-clique arm is new (5 runs); PR-exact equals PP-exact by the exact-coefficient identity. RR/PP reuse is exploratory_only; the user acknowledged that level.
authorization_note: User authorized 15 GPU-hours for the school-side 4090D run and acknowledged the exploratory_only reuse level. The runner still verifies reuse audit, code/data pins, existing outputs and the wall-clock cap.

reuse.note: exploratory_only is not causal certification; the user explicitly acknowledged this level for the school-side screen

PR.training: clique only: new induced_coeff_override runs; exact is identical to PP exact

RP.training: not trained; requires the same override operator with content=real, coefficients=perm0; keep as diagnostic only

exact_identity.statement: exact coefficients depend only on d_i=2+b_i, which the perm0 region permutation preserves; therefore M(perm0, real)=M(perm0, perm0) and M(real, perm0)=M(real, real)
exact_identity.consequence: no new PR-exact training; PR-exact readouts use the archived PP-exact embeddings

probe.readout: MAE of speed from the frozen ridge_a1 probe
probe.split: KFold(5, shuffle=True, random_state=0) over non-NaN speed labels
probe.secondary_subset: eligible same-size-control subset (3,482 labeled) for continuity only

estimands.content_effect: Delta_content,s = E_RR,s - E_PR,s (content change P vs R, coefficients held real); mean and 95% t interval over 5 paired seeds
estimands.coefficient_effect: Delta_coeff,s = E_PR,s - E_PP,s (coefficients real vs perm, content held perm0); same interval
estimands.total_effect: Delta_total,s = E_RR,s - E_PP,s = Delta_content,s + Delta_coeff,s on this path
estimands.path_note: This is a two-step path decomposition (content first, then coefficients). Because training is nonlinear, the reverse path need not give the same split; RP is not trained, so no unique causal share is claimed.

thresholds.interval: two-sided 95% t interval with 4 df over 5 paired seeds
thresholds.rationale: 0.02 is ~43% of the archived all-road perm0 total effect (+0.0462); the negligible band is a precision-bounded equivalence claim, not a non-significance claim

cost.runs_detail: clique, PR arm: perm0 content + real coefficients, seeds 0-4
cost.python_executable_note: set A3_PYTHON on the school host or activate the training env; the runner falls back to sys.executable

platform_observation_4090d.note: archived remote g8p0 5000-episode runs; the 2.5h/run and 12.5h fields are the conservative 3060-based estimate kept for budget checks

cost.budget_basis: wall-clock cumulative time; documented proxy for GPU time; stop before a run that would exceed the cap

stop_rules.meaningful_positive: content contributes in the expected direction; proceed only to a pre-registered independent-confirmation design, not to a new method paper
stop_rules.meaningful_negative: content changes the contrast in the opposite direction; the expected positive explanation fails; archive/merge unless a reversal was pre-registered (it was not)
stop_rules.negligible: content effect negligible within the pre-registered +/-0.01 band with a CI entirely inside it; archive/merge, stop independent topic
stop_rules.inconclusive: stop; do not claim content has no effect and do not add seeds/instances/models
stop_rules.budget_exceeded: stop; report incomplete cells; do not extend or relax thresholds silently

claim_boundaries: One perm0 instance and five training seeds are not independent structural/site samples; this is a gate, not confirmation.
The decomposition is path-dependent; RP is not trained, so Delta_coeff is a coefficient effect at perm0 content, not a unique weight share of the original effect.
The exact arm is content-sensitive but coefficient-invariant; PR-exact=PP-exact does not mean the content change has no effect on exact readouts.
The same-size control remains a secondary restricted re-partition check; its 3,647-node limit is not a general limit of coefficient-fixed content interventions.
No new method or normalization is proposed; a positive result only explains an existing structural evaluation.
RR/PP reuse is exploratory_only: run manifests, archived hashes for all code, and artifact-to-partition identity are unverified.
execution_revision: 2026-10-19: isolated PR outputs; exclusive persistent ledger claim; no automatic restart; fail on missing output
